name: ai-steward
description: Butler for ZCode: parse your instruction into a task card, rewrite the prompt for the target model, dispatch to worker sessions, police their progress, and report only decisions that need you. Ships a local model gateway with auto routing and failover.

description_i18n.en: Butler for ZCode: dispatch, police and report on worker agent sessions; local auto-routing model gateway included.
description_i18n.zh-CN: ZCode 大管家：接令→改写提示词→按任务挑模型→开窗口派单→巡检纠偏→只报要你拍板的事；含本地 Auto 聚合网关（自动路由+故障转移）。
